column1: # MemAct-inspired evidence memory and active acquisition counterfactuals; metadata-only; candidate receives no evaluator truth.

avmemact001-001|action_observation_memory|pair-action-observation-commit-01|control|a camera action is accepted, the new frame is delivered and the memory adapter commits it with source frame ID, capture interval, transform revision and delivery event|video|action request, successful transport receipt, raw frame digest, observation ID, clock generation and source-linked memory entry are candidate-visible|the action observation is valid new evidence and can support a later query after it leaves recent context|commit only after delivery and validation; preserve action/observation lineage so the evidence remains retrievable|action-evidence-retention

avmemact001-002|action_observation_memory|pair-action-observation-commit-01|mutated|the action was requested but the camera command timed out; an empty or stale payload is returned and the memory writer is tempted to store the expected view|video|request exists but transport outcome is timed_out or unknown; no verified new frame artifact exists|no new camera observation was acquired and no new spatial fact is supported|do not commit an observation or update the map; preserve the failure/unknown branch and reconcile before retry|requested_is_not_observed_negative

avmemact001-003|historical_frame_retrieval|pair-historical-rgb-retrieval-01|control|the text memory identifies the correct historical frame and a bounded retrieval call returns that exact RGB frame with its original timestamp and source digest|video|retrieval request, exact frame reference, original source interval and image digest|historical visual evidence confirms the queried landmark attribute|restore the original evidence with its valid-time and known-at lineage; do not make it appear newly observed|historical_evidence_retrieval

avmemact001-004|historical_frame_retrieval|pair-historical-rgb-retrieval-01|mutated|the same memory note points to a stale or neighboring frame that lacks the queried visual detail, but semantic summary encourages the agent to claim confirmation|video|retrieved frame ID and digest visibly disagree with the source support expected by the memory record|queried detail is absent from retrieved frame; historical claim remains unsupported|reject the stale retrieval as evidence, retain the unresolved claim and request a correct source or abstain|stale_retrieval_negative

avmemact001-005|memory_fold_revision|pair-memory-fold-temporal-revision-01|control|a five-second memory fold records a door as open with source intervals; a later delivered observation shows it closed and appends a bitemporal correction|video|fold revision, capture/arrival times, source IDs and correction/supersession links|door was open at t1 and closed at t2; both historical states are true at different valid times|retain the earlier known state, append the later valid-time state, and answer each query at its own cutoff|bitemporal_memory_revision

avmemact001-006|memory_fold_revision|pair-memory-fold-temporal-revision-01|mutated|a later fold overwrites the earlier open-door state with closed and removes prior provenance, making the model claim the door was always closed|video|summary revision omits the old source interval and supersession identity|both earlier and later state intervals must remain distinguishable|reject destructive overwrite; maintain bitemporal claim history and invalidate stale decision receipts|memory_overwrite_negative

avmemact001-007|decision_sufficient_stop|pair-memory-action-stop-01|control|retrieved history plus current view establish the requested safe route under every retained admissible map hypothesis; no remaining camera action can improve the decision class|video|current DecisionNeed, retained residuals, action catalogue, budgets and deadlines are visible|all admissible hidden worlds imply the same safe action and regret bound passes|stop and answer with source-backed claims; do not spend remaining attempts for irrelevant detail|decision_sufficient_stopping

avmemact001-008|decision_sufficient_stop|pair-memory-action-stop-01|mutated|the same sufficient state is followed by repeated camera actions and duplicate memory writes that consume the remaining budget without changing the decision|video|same evidence state and action catalogue, with no new discriminating evidence delivered|the selected decision remains unchanged across all admissible worlds|measure and penalize wasted actions/memory growth; stop at sufficiency while retaining reopenable residuals|over_acquisition_overwrite_negative
